tickets.title: Prepare appreciated stock donation analysis

tickets.title: Review concentrated employer stock for charitable lots

tickets.title: Address charitable giving timeline for CPA filing

tickets.title: Support pending grant recommendation review

tickets.title: Address charitable plan after caregiving change

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the charitable plan after that family caregiving change by April 5, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA-ready charitable documentation packet
tickets.text: Prepare a single CPA-ready charitable documentation packet for Nora Velvetreed that separates donor-advised fund contributions, donor-advised fund grants, and direct charitable gifts for Priya Dewspindle to prevent mixing deductible and non-deductible documentation.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA-ready charitable documentation packet by April 12, 2024.
